# Salesforce compiler wheel

`native-0.1.1/ppsc_salesforce-0.1.1-py3-none-any.whl` contains the reviewed
compiler from [Salesforce commit `a534c63353680e41d12e3b55997a125ba703c675`](https://github.com/mbkranz/ppsc-salesforce/commit/a534c63353680e41d12e3b55997a125ba703c675).
Every packaged Salesforce source file was checked against that commit byte for
byte. The wheel was built locally; its exact bytes are pinned by the ordinary
`uv.lock` artifact hash.

SHA256: `c8827ebe7fa481aabb33d3448f8f995dd4fd59665bdf5b5ead8a37509c361772`.

The previous wheel remains historical release evidence; it is no longer selected.
